You are AutoSkill4Doc's hierarchy linker.
Task: attach one child skill to the best broader parent candidate.
Rules:
- Choose ONLY one parent_skill_id from parent_candidates when a clear broader parent exists.
- Parent must be a broader reusable skill that should call or contain the child skill.
- allowed_parent_nodes is a hard constraint; never attach outside that set.
- Prefer a parent whose workflow has a natural handoff point for the child and whose output or stage makes the child callable as a sub-skill.
- Do not attach merely because domain, family, or wording is similar.
- Prefer defer when multiple parents are similarly plausible or when the best score is still weak.
- If no parent is clearly suitable, return decision=defer.
- Do not invent ids.

  "decision": "attach"|"defer",

{"child_skill": {"skill_id": "688b17b0-4bcf-5eb2-879a-50609da68fe0", "name": "Pydantic 模型级 before/after 校验器实现", "asset_type": "micro_skill", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "asset_level": 3, "objective": "实现模型级 before/after 校验并正确处理原始输入", "applicable_signals": ["约束涉及多个字段或整个模型", "需要在字段校验之前检查原始输入中是否包含禁止字段", "需要在字段校验之后对已解析模型做整体校验"], "contraindications": ["仅涉及单字段校验", "无需访问原始输入数据"], "workflow_steps": ["确定约束是模型级还是字段级，模型级才使用 model_validator", "根据是否需要访问原始输入选择 mode='before'，否则选择 mode='after'", "before 校验器将 data 参数标注为 Any，并先判断类型（如 isinstance(data, dict)）再访问键", "在检测到违规时抛出 ValueError 并给出明确信息", "校验通过时返回 data"], "constraints": ["before 校验器接收的原始输入不一定是字典，需先判断类型", "校验失败应通过抛出 ValueError 终止校验"], "triggers": ["需要跨字段或整体模型约束校验", "需要在 Pydantic 处理前后介入校验"], "output_contract": ["可运行的 model_validator 实现，含 before/after 模式与类型处理"]}, "allowed_parent_nodes": ["workflow_skill"], "parent_candidates": [{"skill_id": "4641701b-2dc0-5429-a380-d65c1c0ec55d", "name": "Pydantic 模型级校验器与 ValidationInfo 使用", "asset_node_id": "workflow_skill", "asset_level": 2, "objective": "实现模型级校验并正确读取校验信息与上下文", "applicable_signals": ["校验规则涉及两个及以上字段的相互依赖", "校验需要读取已校验字段数据（data）", "校验需要读取外部传入的校验上下文（context）"], "workflow_steps": ["判断校验是否确需跨字段依赖或访问校验上下文", "在模型中定义模型级校验器（annotated 或 decorator 模式）", "在校验器中通过 ValidationInfo 读取所需字段数据（data）与上下文（context）", "当校验条件不满足时抛出校验错误", "构造模型实例验证校验器按预期工作"], "output_contract": ["可运行的模型校验器，正确使用 ValidationInfo 数据与上下文，并在条件不满足时产生校验错误"], "score": 0.41034971665914804}]}
